title: Acrimonious
summary: ACRIMO'NIOUS, adjective 1. Sharp; bitter; corrosive; abounding with acrimony. 2. Figuratively, sharpness or severity of temper; bitterness of expression proceeding from anger, ill-nature, or petulance
